lessons.en: Follow PHIVOLCS alert levels and evacuate as soon as officials order it.
lessons.fil: Sundin ang PHIVOLCS alert levels at lumikas agad kapag nag-utos ang mga opisyal.

lessons.en: Never enter the Permanent Danger Zone, even when the volcano looks calm.
lessons.fil: Huwag pumasok sa Permanent Danger Zone, kahit mukhang kalmado ang bulkan.

lessons.en: During ashfall, stay indoors and wear an N95 mask and goggles if you must go out.
lessons.fil: Kapag may ashfall, manatili sa loob ng bahay at magsuot ng N95 mask at goggles kung kailangang lumabas.

lessons.en: Stay away from river channels during heavy rain because lahars can flow down them.
lessons.fil: Lumayo sa mga ilog o daluyan ng tubig mula sa bulkan kapag malakas ang ulan, dahil puwedeng dumaloy doon ang lahar.

question.en: What is the highest PHIVOLCS Volcano Alert Level?
question.fil: Ano ang pinakamataas na PHIVOLCS Volcano Alert Level?

explain.en: Alert levels go from 0 (normal) to 5 (hazardous eruption in progress).
explain.fil: Ang alert levels ay mula 0 (normal) hanggang 5 (may mapanganib na pagputok na nagaganap).

question.en: What do you call a fast flow of volcanic debris mixed with water, often set off by heavy rain, that rushes down river channels?
question.fil: Ano ang tawag sa mabilis na daloy ng volcanic debris na may halong tubig, na kadalasang dulot ng malakas na ulan, at dumadaloy pababa sa mga ilog?

explain.en: Lahars can bury roads and homes far from the volcano, even months or years after an eruption.
explain.fil: Puwedeng matabunan ng lahar ang mga kalsada at bahay na malayo sa bulkan, kahit ilang buwan o taon pagkatapos ng pagputok.

question.en: Volcanic ash is soft like flour and safe to breathe.
question.fil: Ang volcanic ash ay malambot na parang harina at ligtas langhapin.

explain.en: Ash is made of tiny, sharp bits of rock and glass that hurt the lungs and eyes.
explain.fil: Ang abo ay binubuo ng maliliit at matatalas na piraso ng bato at salamin (glass) na nakakasakit sa baga at mata.

question.en: The area around a volcano where no one should live or enter is called the Permanent ____ Zone.
question.fil: Ang lugar sa paligid ng bulkan na hindi dapat tirhan o pasukin ninuman ay tinatawag na Permanent ____ Zone.

explain.en: Eruptions can start with little warning, so the Permanent Danger Zone stays closed at all times.
explain.fil: Puwedeng pumutok ang bulkan nang halos walang babala, kaya laging sarado ang Permanent Danger Zone.

question.en: Match each volcanic hazard with its description.
question.fil: Itugma ang bawat volcanic hazard sa paglalarawan nito.

pairs.en: Fine rock particles falling from the sky
pairs.fil: Pinong piraso ng bato na bumabagsak mula sa langit

pairs.en: Very hot, fast cloud of gas, ash, and rock
pairs.fil: Napakainit at mabilis na ulap ng gas, abo, at bato
Volcanic mudflow na dumadaloy sa mga ilog

pairs.en: Can irritate the eyes, throat, and lungs
pairs.fil: Puwedeng makairita sa mata, lalamunan, at baga

explain.en: Each hazard needs a different response, so it helps to tell them apart.
explain.fil: Iba-iba ang tamang response sa bawat hazard, kaya mahalagang alam mo ang pagkakaiba nila.

question.en: Name 3 supplies that protect a family during ashfall.
question.fil: Magbigay ng 3 supplies na poprotekta sa pamilya habang may ashfall.

show.en: N95 masks, goggles, covered drinking water, food, flashlight, battery radio, medicines, long-sleeved clothes, plastic covers, eyeglasses, first aid kit
show.fil: N95 mask, goggles, nakatakip na inuming tubig, pagkain, flashlight, battery radio, gamot, damit na mahaba ang manggas, plastic na pantakip, salamin sa mata (eyeglasses), first aid kit

explain.en: Masks and goggles protect lungs and eyes, and covered water stays free of ash.
explain.fil: Pinoprotektahan ng mask at goggles ang baga at mata, at hindi napapasukan ng abo ang nakatakip na tubig.

question.en: Ash starts falling on your town, but your barangay is not being evacuated. What should your family do?
question.fil: Nagsimulang bumagsak ang abo sa bayan ninyo, pero hindi pinapalikas ang barangay ninyo. Ano ang dapat gawin ng pamilya mo?

choices.en: Stay indoors, close doors and windows, and cover water containers
choices.fil: Manatili sa loob, isara ang mga pinto at bintana, at takpan ang mga lalagyan ng tubig

choices.en: Go outside to sweep the ash right away
choices.fil: Lumabas agad para walisin ang abo

choices.en: Open the windows so the ash blows through
choices.fil: Buksan ang mga bintana para dumaan ang abo

choices.en: Drive fast to the next town
choices.fil: Magmaneho nang mabilis papunta sa kabilang bayan

explain.en: Staying sheltered limits how much ash you breathe. Ash makes roads slippery and hard to see on.
explain.fil: Kapag nasa loob ka, mas kaunti ang abong malalanghap mo. Nagiging madulas at malabo ang daan dahil sa abo.

question.en: Your barangay orders an evacuation because the alert level was raised. Arrange the steps in order.
question.fil: Nag-utos ang barangay ninyo ng evacuation dahil itinaas ang alert level. Ayusin ang mga hakbang.

steps.en: Hear the official evacuation order from the barangay or radio
steps.fil: Marinig ang official na evacuation order mula sa barangay o radyo

steps.en: Put on your mask and grab the go-bag
steps.fil: Isuot ang mask at kunin ang go-bag

steps.en: Leave with your family using the official route
steps.fil: Umalis kasama ang pamilya gamit ang official na ruta

steps.en: Arrive and register at the evacuation center
steps.fil: Dumating at magpa-register sa evacuation center

steps.en: Stay until authorities say it is safe to return
steps.fil: Manatili hanggang sabihin ng mga awtoridad na ligtas nang bumalik

explain.en: Leaving early, by the official route, keeps families away from danger and helps officials account for everyone.
explain.fil: Ang maagang pag-alis, gamit ang official na ruta, ay naglalayo sa pamilya sa panganib at tumutulong sa mga opisyal na mabilang ang lahat.

scene.en: Weeks after an eruption, it has rained hard for hours. Your house is beside a river that flows down from the volcano. The water is turning thick and gray, and it is carrying rocks and logs.
scene.fil: Ilang linggo pagkatapos ng pagputok, ilang oras nang malakas ang ulan. Nasa tabi ng ilog na galing sa bulkan ang bahay ninyo. Lumalapot at nagiging kulay-abo ang tubig, at may dala na itong mga bato at troso.

choices.en: Stand on the riverbank to watch
Move to higher ground away from the river right away and warn others
choices.fil: Lumipat agad sa mas mataas na lugar, malayo sa ilog, at bigyang-babala ang iba

choices.en: Cross the river to reach a friend
choices.fil: Tumawid sa ilog para puntahan ang kaibigan

explain.en: Thick, rocky water in a river from the volcano may be a lahar. Lahars move fast and follow river channels.
explain.fil: Ang malapot at mabatong tubig sa ilog na galing sa bulkan ay puwedeng lahar. Mabilis ang lahar at sumusunod ito sa mga ilog.
